invariants: Absent sources, borrowed rejection, identity conflict and prepared projection errors retain exact source messages/codes and the original cause value.

A winning live projection failure propagates its exact failure instance and releases the borrowed preparation once.
Retained prepared cuts share one independent lifetime, release only after the last lease, and refuse reuse of a disposed lease with exact Session identity.
Live cuts never borrow persistence; live publication wins a cold read and a detached-live borrow is released before retry.

identity: Exact Session id, cut/revision, root failure/cause identity, lease identity and runtime root/module are retained.
ownership: The reader owns a borrowed preparation until the final prepared lease or a failed read releases it; live cuts have no borrowed persistence lifetime.
ordering: Abort and source identity validation precede publication preference and projection work; disposed live borrow is released before retry.
errors: Source name/code/message and failure identity are compared literally. ThrownValueError is only a Python carrier for the original non-Error rejection.
cancellation: Controlled abort cuts before and after borrow preserve exact signal reason and settle ownership; full durable preparation cancellation remains separate.
adaptation: FileNotFoundError represents typed persistence not-found; generic JavaScript Error disposal refusal maps to exact Python RuntimeError construction. No browser or upstream source is changed.
